requirements: Adaptive scheduling honors dependencies, availability, duration, and project priority, then emits member-specific reassignment and time-change notifications and updated productivity reports.
The completed assignment result atomically revises affected slots while communication, meetings, completed work, and unaffected assignments are preserved.
